newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 25.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency has recommended stricter national standards for emissions of chemicals and particles that cause smog.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton and Chinese President Jiang Zemin agreed to exchange state visits during the next two years.
- Health maintenance organisations are changing the way they pay physicians.
- Survivors of the crash of Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 describe a flight of terror after terrorists hijacked the doomed passenger jet.
- U.S. federal investigators are trying to determine if a swing bridge might have caused an Amtrak train to derail on Saturday.
